questions.stem: A middle-aged woman comes to the physician with complaints of abdominal pain. Physical examination shows a slight and mild tenderness and bulging in the linea semilunaris on the right side. No pain is elicited in McBurney's point, and no neoplasm is seen after a biopsy. The colonic biome is satisfactory. There is no history of surgery. Which of the following disorders explains the above symptoms and signs?
